body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes duplicated calendar events caused by multiple record fetches when `ObjectCalendar` is rendered inside `ObjectView`, by ensuring parent-fetched data is forwarded and by preventing `ObjectView`’s non-grid fetch effect from re-running when `objectSchema` state updates.

**Changes:**
- Forward `data`/`loading` props through `ObjectCalendarRenderer` so `ObjectCalendar` can reuse parent-owned results.
- Update `ObjectCalendar` to accept optional parent-provided `data`/`loading` and skip its internal fetch when those are provided.
- Prevent `ObjectView` from double-fetching on `objectSchema` load, and add `{ value: [...] }` OData response support.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx | Avoids double-fetch by removing `objectSchema` from effect deps (via ref) and supports OData `{ value: [...] }` record extraction. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/index.tsx | Stops stripping `data`/`loading` so parent-provided props reach `ObjectCalendar`. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx | Adds parent-owned `data`/`loading` mode to skip internal fetching and sync externally managed state. |
| packages/plugin-calendar/src/registration.test.tsx | Adds a regression test verifying `data`/`loading` are forwarded by the renderer. |

This result-shape unwrapping duplicates logic that exists in `@object-ui/core` (`extractRecords` supports arrays, `{data}`, `{records}`, and `{value}`). Consider switching to the shared helper to reduce drift (e.g., if new response shapes are added later) and keep extraction consistent across plugins.

`ObjectCalendar` no longer supports inline record arrays provided via `schema.data`. `getDataConfig()` returns `schema.data` as-is, so when `schema.data` is an array (as used in `ObjectCalendar.stories.tsx`), `dataConfig?.provider` is undefined and the fetch effect neither treats it as inline value data nor sets component state from it—resulting in an empty calendar (or an unnecessary fetch against `objectName`). Consider normalizing array data to `{ provider: 'value', items: [...] }` (either in `getDataConfig` or via a dedicated `Array.isArray((schema as any).data)` branch) to preserve existing behavior while still skipping internal fetch when parent-owned `data` is provided.

There’s no regression test in `plugin-view` asserting that non-grid views only trigger a single `dataSource.find()` call when `getObjectSchema()` resolves (the behavior changed by removing `objectSchema` from the effect deps). Since `packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx` exists, consider adding a test that mounts a non-grid view (e.g. calendar/kanban) and verifies `find` is called once per view activation, preventing reintroduction of the double-fetch bug.
